summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buyback program. The issuer purchased ordinary shares on the open market via UBS AG London Branch over April 27-May 1, 2026, with prices ranging from 556.6 GBp to 581.4 GBp. The program was announced on February 16, 2026. Repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Post-settlement, treasury holds 194,253,928 shares with 7,968,726,731 shares outstanding. This is a routine capital return to shareholders through an issuer tender/buyback, not a special situation alteration of the company structure.
